anti_circularity_rules: AEA01 may not be derived from AEA03 or AEA04.
AEA02 may not be derived from AEA03 or AEA04.
AEA03 may reference only frozen AEA01 and AEA02.
AEA04 may reference only frozen AEA01 and AEA02.
forward_complete=true may not create missing U coverage.
reverse_complete=true may not create missing C coverage.
Satisfaction evaluation occurs only after AEA05 closure.
machine_verifiable_ordering_rules: The domain-freeze commit must not contain AEA03 or AEA04 witness instances.
Each AEA03/AEA04 creation commit must be a strict descendant of the frozen U/C commit.
The U-domain SHA-256 at each witness commit must equal the frozen U-domain SHA-256.
The C-domain SHA-256 at each witness commit must equal the frozen C-domain SHA-256.
Witness derivation-input hashes must explicitly bind both frozen domain hashes.
Witness generation must not modify AEA01 or AEA02 bytes.
AEA05 must bind all predecessor and derivation-input hashes before any satisfaction evaluation.

timestamp_semantics.primary_ordering_proof: Git commit ancestry plus immutable SHA-256 artifact bindings
